fire.how_fireplace_opening: Row-gradient edges of the stone jambs' INNER faces, stable across y 600-720 and unchanged when the band is moved to 560-600 or 650-700: the strongest column steps in x 250-650 fall at 341|342 (95.7) and 550|551 (79.1), with the case's outer mouldings at 315 (97.9), 332, 566 and 605. Clear opening = 551 - 342 = 209 px. This reproduces the study-N draft's 341..550 / 209 px exactly.
